status: Exploratory benchmark executed in JavaScript directly on retrieved source data. Python reproduction script syntax-checked and tested on synthetic input; full external corpus not rerun locally.

parameters.ties: fractional top-1 credit; deterministic index for agreement/threshold analyses
parameters.candidate_pool: 54 covered gold terms excluding the two endpoints; any strictly intermediate annotated term is valid
parameters.within_scale: only queries with at least one valid and one out-of-interval covered candidate
parameters.full_graph: conservative match to known reference only; unannotated words not necessarily invalid

limitations: Small exploratory sample; queries share scales and endpoints. No p-values or claim of generalization.
Membership is given in the within-scale test and used only to define the ablation, not to propagate labels.
Reverse graph is a different view of the same associations, not independent evidence.
No pretrained embedding comparison yet; cos baseline uses sparse association vectors.
Missing gold vocabulary excluded; generalization and semantic correctness beyond annotated lists are not established.
The test implements unfiltered diffraction scoring, not the full IA_m pipeline. No GitHub writes.
